# BrainTrack

> BrainTrack (braintrack.tech) is a South African Grade 12 (Matric) exam-preparation platform. It combines 10 years of official DBE NSC past papers with memos (2015–2025), a CAPS-aligned weekly study plan, an AI tutor ("Rizz"), exam-readiness tracking and weekly parent progress reports. The full platform is bilingual: English and Afrikaans.

BrainTrack is operated by KTH Projects (Pty) Ltd t/a KTH-Tech (South African company registration 2025/627290/07). It serves South African learners preparing for the National Senior Certificate (NSC), and works with partner schools across South Africa. Payments are processed in South African Rand (ZAR) by Paystack; learner accounts for under-18s require a parent-consent step, and the platform is built for POPIA compliance.

## Products and pricing (ZAR, see https://braintrack.tech/subscribe)

- Student Life — R169 per month, recurring, cancel anytime. Full access: every CAPS subject, the full 10-year past-paper archive, Rizz AI tutor, adaptive study plan, weekly parent reports.
- Prelim Sprint — R250 once-off. 6 weeks of full access built for the prelim exams: prelim-mode drills, mocks and predictor, 3 most recent years of past papers + memos. No recurring billing.
- Finals Blitz — R250 once-off. 6 weeks of full access built for the October–November NSC finals: finals-mode drills, mocks and predictor, 3 most recent years of past papers + memos. No recurring billing.
- Exam Season Pass — R550 once-off. Full platform access until 15 December 2026, including the full 10-year past-paper archive. No recurring billing.

## Facts

- Geography: South Africa only (pricing in ZAR, curriculum is the South African DBE CAPS curriculum, exam target is the NSC).
- Languages: English (en-ZA) and Afrikaans (af-ZA) — same URLs, in-app language toggle. Afrikaans users search terms like "matriek vraestelle en memorandums" and "Graad 12 vorige vraestelle".
- Audience: Grade 12 learners (matriculants), their parents, and South African high schools.
- Contact: learn@kth-tech.com
- Sitemap: https://braintrack.tech/sitemap.xml
